# Benson Heating & Air Conditioning

> > Licensed HVAC contractor serving Barrie and Simcoe County with residential heating, cooling, and ventilation services backed by 30+ years of experience.

Benson Heating & Air Conditioning is led by TSSA-licensed technician Kevin Benson, specializing in installation and service of major HVAC brands including Keeprite, Heil, Carrier, Bryant, Mitsubishi, and Tempstar. The company provides comprehensive furnace, air conditioning, heat pump, and HRV services throughout Barrie, Ontario and surrounding York Region communities.

## Key Topics

- HVAC installation and service
- Furnace installation and repair
- Air conditioning systems
- Heat pumps and ductless systems
- HRV and ventilation solutions
- TSSA licensed technician
- Barrie and Simcoe County service area
- Keeprite, Heil, Carrier, Bryant brands
- Residential HVAC services
- Gas furnace service
- Warranty and maintenance
- Kevin Benson - 30+ years experience
- ICP dealer certification
